|   `-- [I] This alternative tracks lending uses; it is not management FCF.

|   `-- [S] Expected Q2 FCF-margin tailwind: about 0.5 percentage point.
`-- [S] Q3 2026: $816M FCF; 22% margin.

        and cash-advance accounting, each roughly equally sized.
